name: Ferienwohnung Baumgartner Gisela
beschreibung:
Located in the famous Haflinger village of Ebbs, Ferienwohnung Baumgartner Gisela welcomes guests with genuine Tyrolean hospitality. The well-tended and comfortably furnished property ensures restful holidays in Kufsteinerland.

The celebrated Fohlenhof stud farm, scenic hiking trails into the Kaiser valley, and pleasant cycling paths are all close by.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Baumgartner Gisela in Ebbs provides cosy holiday comfort at the foot of the Zahmer Kaiser mountains.
